newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Leftist rebels skyjack a small plane in Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Leftist rebels skyjack a small plane in Colombia.

text.p: Leftist rebels hijacked a light aircraft on a flight in eastern Colombia and took it to a secret location, aviation authorities said on Friday.
The Piper BA34 plane took off from an airstrip in the town of Arauquita in Arauca province on Thursday afternoon and disappeared without a trace.

Co-pilot Ruben Dario Lizcano managed to escape and made his way to the city of Cucuta in neighbouring Norte de Santander province on Friday afternoon, a spokesman for Colombia's civil aviation authority said.
Lizcano told police two men chartered the flight from Arauca and then ordered pilot Rafael Ramirez to land at a clandestine airstrip.
"I think it is likely that the guerrillas will use this aircraft to move material," the spokesman said.
Arauca province is a stronghold of the National Liberation Army (ELN), Colombia's second-largest rebel group.
